verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਭਜ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal bhaj kamal pragaas bhe dharas dharas sam dharas dhikhaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: By taking refuge of Sat guru's lotus feet, a devotee's mind )0 blooms like lotus flower. By the blessings of a True Guru, he treats and conducts himself alike with all and sundry. He carries no rancour for anyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਭਏ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰ ਛਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat anahadh liv leen bhe unaman magan gagan pur chhaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: Such Guru-conscious person attaches his mind in the unstruck celestial music and enjoying heavenley bliss, rests his mind in the Dasam Duar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: prem ras bas hoi bisam bidheh bhe at asacharaj mai herat hiraae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: Enamoured by the love of Lord, he does not remain conscious of his body any more. This is such a wondrous state that surprises everyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal mahimaa agaadh bodh akath kathaa binodh kahat na aae hai(n) ||33||

en.bdb: The spiritually ecstatic state of a Guru's disciple cannot even be praised. It is beyond contemplation and indescribable too. (33)
